lead: Bassist, composer, and Coordinator of the Al Whittle Theatre in Wolfville, Nova Scotia.
bio: I play electric bass and compose. I perform with the **[Mitchell McFadgen Trio](https://mitchellmcfadgentrio.live/)** around the Maritimes, and I write for jazz trio, solo piano, and solo electric guitar.

I studied music at Acadia University, graduating in 2025 with a Bachelor of Music; before that I studied science and engineering. Since September 2026 I have been Coordinator of the **[Al Whittle Theatre](https://www.alwhittletheatre.ca/)**, where I manage staff and volunteers, front of house, technical and projection operations, and the theatre's website and calendar.
Outside of music I'm interested in computing. I run a number of services on a server at home, and I write small scripts and tools. Some of that work is on GitHub.
I live in Grand Pré, Nova Scotia.
